fact: The Office of the Accountant General's letter of 29 August 2026 refers to the existing government payroll system, to be linked to NIRA's national ID system from a pilot on 1 October 2026; the document's published date is used as no event date is given for the system itself.

The letter refers to the Somali Financial Management Information System (SFMIS) as an existing system to be integrated with NIRA's identification system; published date used as no event date is given.
The FY2025 annual report states digital signatures were introduced in SFMIS to re-engineer payment processes and its budget preparation module was enhanced for use in the 2027 budget.

The report states the Electronic Tax Administration System (ETAS) and other digital platforms improved automation and streamlined revenue collection in 2025, with total domestic revenue of USD 404.3 million.

The Ministry of Finance's PFM Reform Strategy 2026-2030 reports that the Somalia Financial Management Information System (SFMIS) was implemented, with paperless commitment-to-payment processes, an operational asset management module, a link to the Central Bank's core banking system and SFMIS rolled out to the Federal Member States under SERP; no event date is given, so the document's published date is used.

PFM Smart says the Ministry of Finance signed a contract on 8 September 2026 to enhance and roll out the existing Somali Financial Management Information System (SFMIS) across the federal government and four member states, moving them off the BISAN platform.
